	      			             	  		  			 Our Story     Early Years     SDM College of Dental Sciences & Hospital
 was founded in 1986 by the SDME Society, Ujire of which Sriman Dr.D.Veerendra Heggade, Dharmadhikari of Dharmasthala is the President with a vision to train st
udents to excel in knowledge, skills and service to the community. The mission of the institution was to improve oral health of the local population and to cate
r to their dental needs. It had a humble beginning with an intake of 40 students in the premises of SDM Engineering College Dharwad.   In 1987, a small dental h
ospital with 6 dental surgery chairs and units was commissioned in the town center at Dharwad. Two years later in 1989 the hospital was expanded to include all 
clinical departments and shifted to a larger building near the bus station. In the same year 10 acres land was acquired between Dharwad and Hubli on the Nationa
l Highway to develop an independent campus with all required infra-structural facilities.   		  	           	  		 		
  			    		  	         	  		  			 THE TRANSITIONAL YEARS   The year of 1991 remains a mil
estone in the history of the institution. Both the college and hospital were shifted to this monumental building exclusively designed for dental education and s
ervice. The college and hospital started functioning here with state of art equipments. By then the institution had established an excellent rapport with the co
mmunity through its distinguished services. The Dental Council Of India recognized the BDS course offered by the institution in 1991. Inspired by this and to ex
cel further postgraduate courses were started in 1992 in all the nine specialities of dentistry. The number of undergraduate admissions were raised to 100 in th
e same year.   		  	             	  		  			   YEARS OF DEVELOPMENT     Having established pride as a center of exce
llence for advanced learning, the institution had pro-actively decided to develop international academic linkage. As an out come of this lateral thinking, The R
oyal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Glasgow recognized the institute as the only center in India for conducting Primary FDSRCPS examination in 1995. Late
r on, First Part of FRCS was added. Currently, the institution conducts Part A and B of MFDS, Membership Examination in Maxillofacial Surgery and Morth examinat
ion of the RCPS, Glasgow. In 1993, institution started the first Department of Oral Implantology in the Country with the support of Prof. Hans L. Grafelmann. Th
e visit of Prof. P.I. Branemark to this institute in 1994 gave the much needed impetus to the practice of implantology in the Country. In-patient services in th
e Department of Maxillofacial Surgery were started in 1992 with 20 beds and a single operating room.   		  	           	  		  	
		 What started of as a modest school is today a renowned Institution. Tomorrow is going to be   Even Brighter   		  	                
   	  		  			   ROAD AHEAD   With the years having passed by the college has justified the high confidence reposed in it by a
ll sections of the Society. Today the institution stands out as a glowing example of a humane, yet efficient organisation. In the days ahead the college plans o
n providing a host of value added services with quality remaining unchanged. The future plans include:         Bringing in state of the art Techonologies in its
 working environments.   Pursuing Collaborations/Strategic Alliances across the seas for wider exposures.   To aim at having a Deemed University Status.
